# Load Libraries
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

## install packages if you dont already have them
if (!require("tidyverse")) install.packages("tidyverse")
if (!require("broom")) install.packages("broom")

# load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(ggplot2)

```

# Import data
```{r}
# Helper: read wide-format Gen5 plate reader CSV and return tidy well × absorbance data
read_prot_plate <- function(filepath) {
  raw <- read_csv(filepath, skip = 25, col_names = FALSE, show_col_types = FALSE)
  col_nums <- unlist(raw[1, 3:14])           # plate column numbers 1–12 from header row
  raw %>%
    slice(-1) %>%                            # drop header row
    select(2:14) %>%                         # row letter + 12 data columns
    set_names(c("row", col_nums)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-row, names_to = "col_num", values_to = "abs562") %>%
    mutate(well   = paste0(row, col_num),
           abs562 = as.numeric(abs562)) %>%
    select(well, `562:562` = abs562)
}

# List protein data files
prot_path = "data/protein/"                                              # Path to prot data directory
all_prot_files <- list.files(path = prot_path, pattern = "*.csv")          # List all files in directory
prot_platemaps <- list.files(path = prot_path, pattern = "platemap")       # List platemap files
prot_data_files <- setdiff(all_prot_files, prot_platemaps)                 # List data files

# Read in all files into tibble
df <- tibble(file = prot_data_files) %>%
  mutate(plate = str_remove(file, "_prot\\.csv")) %>%          # e.g., "20261021_Plate1_Host"
  separate(plate, into = c("date", "plate_num", "fraction"),
           sep = "_", remove = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(platemap = map(plate, ~read_csv(paste0(prot_path, ., "_prot_platemap.csv")) %>%
                          mutate(colony_id = str_trim(colony_id))),  # trim whitespace from colony_id
         # prot_sym_dilution = uL of 1x PBS added to the aliquot before this run
         # (blank or absent column = undiluted)
         platemap = map2(platemap, plate, function(pm, plate_name) {
           if (!"prot_sym_dilution" %in% names(pm)) pm$prot_sym_dilution <- NA_character_
           dil_raw <- as.character(pm$prot_sym_dilution)
           dil_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(dil_raw))
           # Text entered in this column (e.g. a note) is not a dilution; report and treat as undiluted
           notes <- !is.na(dil_raw) & trimws(dil_raw) != "" & is.na(dil_num)
           if (any(notes)) {
             cat("Non-numeric prot_sym_dilution treated as undiluted in", plate_name, ":\n")
             print(data.frame(well = pm$well[notes], colony_id = pm$colony_id[notes], value = dil_raw[notes]))
           }
           pm$prot_sym_dilution <- replace_na(dil_num, 0)
           pm
         }),
         prot_data = map(file, ~read_prot_plate(paste0(prot_path, .))))

# Resolve platemap labels to the canonical colony_id (see make_colony_id.Rmd).
# Some plate maps were written with another tube-label format (e.g. colony_id_tp_R,
# "JC_40_T0_R2"); look each label up across all four ID columns in the sample info.
sample_ids <- read.csv("data/sample_info_colony_id.csv")

id_lookup <- sample_ids %>%
  select(canonical = colony_id, colony_id, colony_id_tp_R, colony_id_tp_pad, colony_id_R_tp) %>%
  pivot_longer(-canonical, values_to = "label") %>%
  distinct(label, canonical)

stopifnot("a platemap label matches more than one colony_id" = !anyDuplicated(id_lookup$label))

df <- df %>%
  mutate(platemap = map(platemap, ~ .x %>%
                          left_join(id_lookup, by = c("colony_id" = "label")) %>%
                          mutate(colony_id = coalesce(canonical, colony_id)) %>%
                          select(-canonical)))

# Fail if any sample label still matches no colony_id (excluding standards, blanks, empty wells)
unmatched_labels <- df %>%
  select(plate, platemap) %>%
  unnest(platemap) %>%
  filter(!is.na(colony_id), colony_id != "BLANK", !grepl("Standard", colony_id),
         !colony_id %in% sample_ids$colony_id) %>%
  distinct(plate, colony_id)

if (nrow(unmatched_labels) > 0) {
  print(unmatched_labels, n = Inf)
  stop(n_distinct(unmatched_labels$colony_id),
       " platemap label(s) match no ID column in data/sample_info_colony_id.csv; fix the platemap or sample info.")
}

# Merge platemap and data for each plate
df <- df %>%
  mutate(merged = map2(platemap, prot_data, ~ right_join(.x, .y)))
```

# Plot standard curve
```{r}
# Create standard curve following kit instructions
standards <- tribble(
  ~std, ~BSA_ug.mL,
  "A",        2000,
  "B",        1500,
  "C",        1000,
  "D",         750,
  "E",         500,
  "F",         250,
  "G",         125,
  "H",          25,
  "I",           0
)

# Collect all standard wells (Host and Sym plates each have their own standards)
std_curve <- df %>%
  unnest(merged) %>%
  filter(grepl("Standard", colony_id)) %>%
  select(date, plate, well, colony_id, abs562 = `562:562`) %>%
  rename(std = colony_id) %>%
  mutate(std = str_sub(std, 9, 9),
         # Host and Sym are read as separate plates, each with its own standards
         fraction = str_extract(plate, "Host|Sym")) %>%
  #group_by(std) %>%
  #summarise(abs562 = mean(abs562)) %>%                       # calculate mean of standard duplicates
  #mutate(abs562.adj = abs562 - abs562[std == "I"]) %>%       # subtract blank absorbace value from all
  left_join(standards) %>%
  # Exclude one 750 ug/mL standard that reads ~1.30 (its duplicate reads 0.99, and 1000 ug/mL
  # standards read ~1.27-1.32), likely a pipetting or labeling error
  filter(!(plate == "20261026_Plate8_Sym" & well == "A4"))

## Fit one quadratic model per date and fraction using that fraction's standards
# (object keeps the name lm_models; BCA standards are curved, and a linear fit
# predicted negative concentrations at low absorbance. Host and Sym standards can
# differ a lot within a date, e.g. 20261022, so they are not pooled.)
lm_models <- std_curve %>%
  group_by(date, fraction) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    mod    = map(data, ~ lm(BSA_ug.mL ~ abs562 + I(abs562^2), data = .x)),
    fitted = map(mod, broom::augment),
    label  = map2_chr(mod, data, ~{
      cf <- coef(.x)
      r2 <- summary(.x)$r.squared
      sprintf("BSA = %.1f + %.1f \u00d7 Abs + %.1f \u00d7 Abs\u00b2\nR\u00b2 = %.4f",
              cf[1], cf[2], cf[3], r2)
    })
  )

# Plot standard curve from lm fit
std_curve_plot <- std_curve %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = abs562, y = BSA_ug.mL, color = date)) +
  geom_point(size = 3)

Stnd_lm <- std_curve_plot +
  geom_line(data = lm_models %>% unnest(fitted),
            aes(x = abs562, y = .fitted, color = date)) +
  geom_label(data = lm_models %>%
               unnest(fitted) %>%
               group_by(date, fraction, label) %>%
               slice_max(abs562, n = 1) %>%
               ungroup(),
             aes(x = abs562, y = .fitted, label = label, color = date),
             hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = 2.5,
             inherit.aes = FALSE, show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~fraction) +
  labs(title = "Standard curve (quadratic fit, per date and fraction)")
Stnd_lm

```

# Calculate protein concentrations
```{r}
# Calculate protein concentration for all samples using the date- and fraction-matched standard curve
prot <- df %>%
  unnest(merged) %>%
  filter(!grepl("Standard", colony_id)) %>%                     # Get just samples (not standards)
  select(date, plate, fraction, well, colony_id, prot_sym_dilution, abs562 = `562:562`) %>%  # Select only needed columns
  filter(!is.na(colony_id)) %>%                                 # Filter out empty wells
  filter(colony_id != "BLANK") %>%                              # Filter out blank wells
  left_join(lm_models %>% select(date, fraction, mod), by = c("date", "fraction")) %>%  # Join matched model
  mutate(prot_ug.mL = map2_dbl(abs562, mod,                     # Predict using the matched model
                                ~predict(.y, newdata = data.frame(abs562 = .x)))) %>%
  select(-mod)                                                  # Drop model column

std_curve_plot + 
  geom_point(data = prot, aes(x = abs562, y = prot_ug.mL, color = fraction), pch = "X", cex = 5, alpha = 0.3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Host" = "coral", "Sym" = "green")) +
  facet_wrap(~fraction) +
  labs(title = "All samples projected on standard curve")
```

# Outlier check
```{r}
# Absorbance bounds from the standard curve for each date and fraction.
# Lower bound: the absorbance where the curve predicts 0 ug/mL, or the lowest standard
# absorbance if the curve is already positive there. Upper bound: highest standard.
std_range <- std_curve %>%
  group_by(date, fraction) %>%
  summarise(abs_min = min(abs562), abs_hi = max(abs562), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(lm_models %>% select(date, fraction, mod), by = c("date", "fraction")) %>%
  mutate(abs_lo = pmap_dbl(list(mod, abs_min, abs_hi), function(m, lo, hi) {
    pred <- function(a) predict(m, data.frame(abs562 = a))
    if (pred(lo) >= 0) lo else uniroot(pred, c(lo, hi))$root
  })) %>%
  select(date, fraction, abs_lo, abs_hi)

# Wells reading up to this fraction above the top standard's absorbance are kept (slight
# extrapolation of the curve); e.g. 0.05 allows absorbance up to 5% above the top standard
abs_hi_tolerance <- 0.05

# Flag: (1) absorbance below the standard curve range (below detection; kept, concentration
# clamped to 0), (2) absorbance above the top standard plus tolerance (removed),
# (3) within-plate duplicate CV > 30% (removed)
prot_outliers <- prot %>%
  left_join(std_range, by = c("date", "fraction")) %>%
  group_by(colony_id, plate) %>%
  mutate(CV = sd(abs562) / mean(abs562) * 100) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(flag_low  = abs562 < abs_lo,
         flag_high = abs562 > abs_hi * (1 + abs_hi_tolerance),
         flag_cv   = CV > 30)

# Print any flagged samples
prot_outliers %>%
  filter(flag_low | flag_high | flag_cv) %>%
  select(date, plate, colony_id, well, abs562, prot_ug.mL, CV, flag_low, flag_high, flag_cv) %>%
  arrange(colony_id) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

# Plot absorbance per sample; shape = flagged
prot_outliers %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(colony_id, abs562), y = abs562, color = fraction,
             shape = flag_low | flag_high | flag_cv)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = abs_lo), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = abs_hi), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Host" = "coral", "Sym" = "green"), name = "Fraction") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("FALSE" = 16, "TRUE" = 4),
                     labels = c("OK", "Flagged"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Sample", y = "Absorbance (562 nm)", title = "Outlier check") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```


# Remove outliers
```{r}
# Colony+plate groups flagged for high CV (both replicates removed)
high_cv_groups <- prot_outliers %>%
  filter(flag_cv) %>%
  distinct(colony_id, plate)

# Full list of removed wells with reason
removed_samples <- prot_outliers %>%
  filter(flag_high | flag_cv) %>%
  mutate(reason = case_when(
    flag_high & flag_cv ~ "above top standard + tolerance; high CV",
    flag_high           ~ "above top standard + tolerance",
    flag_cv             ~ "high CV (>30%)"
  )) %>%
  select(date, plate, colony_id, well, abs562, prot_ug.mL, CV, reason)

print(removed_samples)
write_csv(removed_samples, "output/protein_removed_samples.csv")

# Remove wells above the top standard and entire high-CV groups. Wells below the standard
# curve range are kept: their concentration is clamped to 0 and they are marked
# below_detection (the curve predicts a negative value there)
prot <- prot_outliers %>%
  filter(!flag_high) %>%
  anti_join(high_cv_groups, by = c("colony_id", "plate")) %>%
  mutate(below_detection = flag_low,
         prot_ug.mL      = if_else(flag_low, pmax(prot_ug.mL, 0), prot_ug.mL)) %>%
  select(-abs_lo, -abs_hi, -CV, -flag_low, -flag_high, -flag_cv)
```

# Calculate mean of technical duplicates and Normalize to surface area
```{r}

# Calculate mean of technical replicates within each plate
prot.mean <- prot %>% 
  group_by(date, plate, fraction, colony_id, prot_sym_dilution) %>%
  summarise(prot_ug.mL       = mean(prot_ug.mL, na.rm = TRUE),
            below_detection  = any(below_detection),
            .groups = "drop")


# Surface area data
sa <- read.csv("output/surface_area_calculated.csv")

# Tissue homogenate volume data (dilution is recorded per run in the plate maps instead)
homog_vols <- read.csv("data/homogenate_vols.csv") %>%
  select(-any_of("prot_sym_dilution"))

# Coral sample metadata
metadata <- read.csv("data/sample_info_colony_id.csv") 

# Join homogenate volumes and surface area with sample metadata
metadata <- full_join(metadata, homog_vols) %>%
  full_join(sa)

# Dilution protocol: the aliquot was 500 uL; 50 uL (2 x 25 uL) was removed for the first
# assay, leaving 450 uL. prot_sym_dilution uL of PBS was then added to the remaining volume.
aliquot_ul       <- 500
assay_removed_ul <- 50
remaining_ul     <- aliquot_ul - assay_removed_ul

# Join prot data with metadata
prot.calc <- left_join(prot.mean, metadata, by="colony_id") %>%
  mutate(plate_num       = as.integer(str_extract(plate, "(?<=Plate)\\d+")),
         # uL of PBS added before this run, from the plate map
         pbs_added_ul    = prot_sym_dilution,
         dilution_factor = (remaining_ul + pbs_added_ul) / remaining_ul,
         diluted_repeat  = pbs_added_ul > 0,
         # Back-calculate concentration of the undiluted homogenate
         prot_ug.mL      = prot_ug.mL * dilution_factor,
         prot_ug         = prot_ug.mL * homog_vol_ml,
         prot_ug.cm2     = prot_ug / surface.area.cm2,
         prot_mg.cm2     = prot_ug.cm2 / 1000,
         # Corrected concentration exceeds the top standard (informational; not removed)
         flag_above_top_std = prot_ug.mL > max(standards$BSA_ug.mL))

prot.calc %>%
  filter(flag_above_top_std) %>%
  select(plate, colony_id, fraction, diluted_repeat, dilution_factor, prot_ug.mL) %>%
  print()

# Dilution is primarily expected for Sym runs
stopifnot(!any(prot.calc$diluted_repeat & prot.calc$fraction != "Sym"))
```

# Check for duplicates within and across plates; retain most recent run
```{r}
# Within-plate duplicates (same colony_id appearing more than once on the same plate)
within_plate_dups <- prot.calc %>%
  group_by(date, plate,fraction, colony_id) %>%
  filter(n() > 1) %>%
  ungroup()

if (nrow(within_plate_dups) > 0) {
  warning(nrow(within_plate_dups), " within-plate duplicate(s) found:")
  print(within_plate_dups %>% select(date, plate, colony_id, prot_ug.mL))
} else {
  cat("No within-plate duplicates found.\n")
}

# Across-plate duplicates (same colony_id run on more than one plate)
across_plate_dups <- prot.calc %>%
  group_by(colony_id, fraction) %>%
  filter(n() > 1) %>%
  ungroup()

if (nrow(across_plate_dups) > 0) {
  cat(n_distinct(across_plate_dups$colony_id), "colony_id(s) run on multiple plates:\n")
  print(across_plate_dups %>%
          select(date, plate, colony_id, prot_ug.mL) %>%
          arrange(colony_id, date))
} else {
  cat("No across-plate duplicates found.\n")
}

# Keep one run for each colony_id + fraction combination: prefer a run that is not below
# detection, then the diluted repeat if one exists, otherwise the most recent run
# (date is YYYYMMDD; plate_num breaks same-day ties)
prot.calc <- prot.calc %>%
  arrange(below_detection, desc(diluted_repeat), desc(date), desc(plate_num)) %>%
  distinct(colony_id, fraction, .keep_all = TRUE)

cat("Retained", nrow(prot.calc), "unique samples after deduplication.\n")

# Write protein data to output file
prot.calc <- prot.calc %>%
  select(original_id, colony_id, fraction, timepoint, site, prot_ug, prot_mg.cm2, below_detection) %>%
  filter(!is.na(timepoint)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(prot_mg.cm2))

# Holo = total protein (Host + Sym). Only computed for colonies with both fractions retained,
# so a missing fraction gives no Holo value rather than a Host- or Sym-only total.
holo <- prot.calc %>%
  group_by(original_id, colony_id, timepoint, site) %>%
  filter(all(c("Host", "Sym") %in% fraction)) %>%
  summarise(prot_ug         = sum(prot_ug[fraction %in% c("Host", "Sym")]),
            prot_mg.cm2     = sum(prot_mg.cm2[fraction %in% c("Host", "Sym")]),
            below_detection = any(below_detection),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(fraction = "Holo")

prot.calc <- bind_rows(prot.calc, holo) %>%
  select(original_id, colony_id, fraction, timepoint, site, prot_ug, prot_mg.cm2, below_detection) %>%
  write_csv(file = "output/protein_calcs.csv")

```


#plot by site and timepoint
```{r}

dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.5)

prot.calc |>
  ggplot(aes(x = timepoint, y = prot_mg.cm2, color = site, group = site)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 1,
             position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.05, dodge.width = 0.5)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", position = dodge) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", position = dodge) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.1, position = dodge) +
  facet_wrap(~factor(fraction, levels = c("Host", "Sym", "Holo"))) +
  labs(x = "Timepoint", y = expression("Protein (mg cm"^-2*")"), color = "Site") +
  theme_bw()

ggsave("output/protein_by_site_timepoint.pdf", width = 10, height = 5)


```
